sizing.size_usd_rule: min(severity_r x market value, market value); i.e. risk_removed = severity_r x R_open, R_open = mv x stop_pct/100
sizing.severity_unit: fraction of the position's OWN open risk (R_base is the unit for entries and trim_risk_cap only)

severity_r_computed.trim_risk_cap: (R_open - R_base) / R_base -- trims exactly to the ATR cap
severity_r_computed.cluster_consolidation: full exit of the dropped name

exit_or_hold.rule: residual < min_position or trim > 60% -> full exit; a position already < min_position is never partially trimmed

sizing.rotation_buy_rule: buy = min(buy R_ticket, R_freed) / buy stop, then headroom / cluster room / deployable cash; rotation_risk names the bound

materiality.rule: ticket >= max(min_ticket_usd, min_ticket_pct_of_book% x book, min_ticket_r x r_base / stop, fee_cover_mult x round-trip fee); sub-floor -> vote below_materiality; full exits exempt

heat_budget.rule: H_eff_max = H_max x (heat_floor + (1 - heat_floor) x (1 - rho)); R_free = max(0, H_eff_max - H); H = aggregate_open_risk_usd, H_max = aggregate_open_risk_cap_pct_of_book x total book
heat_budget.unmeasured_correlation: rho treated as 1.0 (conservative bound), never as 0
heat_budget.allocation: pairs first (net = buy risk - the risk their own sell frees), then singles greedily by smith_ticket.allocation_priority; a partial fit is sized to the remaining room only if it still clears materiality, else the ticket is DEFERRED (vote 'deferred', never dropped)
heat_budget.over_cap: H > H_eff_max -> zero new net-risk buys; sells and net<=0 rotations still emit; no sell credit is taken
heat_budget.sell_credit: OFF: a proposed standalone sell has not freed anything (STANDALONE_SELL_CREDIT_ENABLED); only a rotation's own sell leg offsets its own buy

heat_budget.ordering_key: smith_ticket.allocation_priority (EV_R desc -- EV per unit of risk; conviction_score only for a candidate with no EV)
